repos.description: AI turns documents or topics into real, native PowerPoint decks—with native shapes, transitions and animations, data-backed charts and tables on demand, audio narration from speaker notes, and support for your own .pptx templates. · by Hugo He
repos.summary_zh: PPT Master 是一款开源 AI 工具，能将任意文档转化为原生可编辑的 PPTX 文件，支持原生形状、动画效果及演讲者备注转语音旁白，并可应用自定义模板。相比生成静态幻灯片图片，它生成真正可编辑的演示文稿，大幅提升内容复用与二次编辑效率，适合教育、汇报、技术分享等场景。
repos.summary_en: PPT Master is an open-source AI tool that converts any document into a natively editable PPTX file, preserving native shapes, animations, and speaker notes with optional audio narration. It supports custom .pptx templates instead of static slide images, enabling full post-generation editing. Ideal for education, presentations, and technical sharing where editable, reusable slide decks are essential.

repos.description: VoxCPM2: Tokenizer-Free TTS for Multilingual Speech Generation, Creative Voice Design, and True-to-Life Cloning
repos.summary_zh: VoxCPM2 是 OpenBMB 推出的无分词器文本转语音系统，基于端到端扩散自回归架构直接生成连续语音表征，无需离散分词。2B 参数模型在超 200 万小时多语言语音数据上训练，支持 30 种语言、自然语言驱动的创意语音设计、可控语音克隆及 48kHz 录音室级音频输出，RTX 4090 上 RTF 低至 0.3，适合多语言 TTS、个性化语音定制与高质量语音克隆场景。
repos.summary_en: VoxCPM2 by OpenBMB is a tokenizer-free text-to-speech system that directly generates continuous speech representations via an end-to-end diffusion autoregressive architecture, bypassing discrete tokenization. The 2B-parameter model is trained on over 2 million hours of multilingual speech data, supporting 30 languages, natural-language-driven creative voice design, controllable voice cloning, and 48kHz studio-quality audio output. With RTF as low as ~0.3 on RTX 4090, it is ideal for multilingual TTS, personalized voice customization, and high-fidelity voice cloning applications.

repos.description: 网易云音乐 Node.js API service
repos.summary_zh: 网易云音乐 Node.js API 服务，提供音乐播放、歌单获取、用户信息查询等功能，支持无版权限制访问。因版权政策调整，项目已停止维护，建议用户注意合规使用。
repos.summary_en: Netease Cloud Music Node.js API service offering music playback, playlist retrieval, and user data access. Now deprecated due to copyright policy changes; users advised to ensure compliance.

repos.description: 插件化、定制化、无广告的免费音乐播放器
repos.summary_zh: MusicFree 是一款开源、无广告、插件化的免费音乐播放器，专为 Android 和 Harmony OS 设计。其核心特性包括完全本地化数据存储、支持自定义主题与歌词关联功能。通过插件架构，用户可接入第三方音源（如音乐搜索、歌单导入、歌词获取），实现高度定制化体验。项目基于 AGPL 3.0 协议开源，强调隐私保护与合法合规使用。
repos.summary_en: MusicFree is an open-source, ad-free, plugin-based music player for Android and Harmony OS. It features local data storage, customizable themes, and lyric linking. Its plugin architecture enables integration with third-party audio sources for search, playback, and playlist import. Built on AGPL 3.0, it prioritizes privacy and ethical use without VIP or cracked content.

repos.description: Buzz transcribes and translates audio offline on your personal computer. Powered by OpenAI's Whisper.
repos.summary_zh: Buzz是一款基于OpenAI Whisper的本地音频转录与翻译工具，支持离线运行。具备多硬件加速、实时麦克风转录、语音分离与说话人识别功能，可将音视频转为TXT/SRT/VTT字幕文件，适配Windows/macOS/Linux全平台。
repos.summary_en: Buzz is a local audio transcription and translation tool powered by OpenAI Whisper, running entirely offline. It features multi-hardware acceleration (CUDA/Apple Silicon/Vulkan), real-time microphone input, voice separation, and speaker identification, with export to TXT/SRT/VTT formats across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

repos.description: 一个第三方音乐播放器、本地服务、桌面歌词、音乐下载、远程控制
repos.summary_zh: AlgerMusicPlayer 是一款功能强大的第三方跨平台音乐播放器，支持网易云账号登录、本地服务、桌面歌词、音乐下载及远程控制。基于 Electron 和 Vue 开发，提供沉浸式歌词显示、EQ均衡器、多语言界面和明暗主题切换，支持全平台运行（桌面/Web/移动端），兼顾高品质音质与个性化体验。
repos.summary_en: AlgerMusicPlayer is a powerful third-party cross-platform music player supporting NetEase Cloud login, local services, desktop lyrics, music downloads, and remote control. Built with Electron and Vue, it offers immersive lyrics, EQ equalizer, multi-language UI, dark/light themes, and high-fidelity audio, running on Desktop, Web, and Mobile platforms with personalized features.

repos.description: 一款以电影镜头、粒子视觉和歌词舞台为核心的沉浸式音乐播放器。
repos.summary_zh: Mineradio 是一款基于 Electron 的 Windows 桌面沉浸式音乐播放器，融合电影镜头视觉、粒子动画与歌词舞台，打造私人音乐空间。支持网易云/QQ音乐接入、3D歌单架、自定义封面与本地 MP4 播放，项目当前长期停更。
repos.summary_en: Mineradio is an Electron-based Windows desktop immersive music player featuring cinematic visual effects, particle animations, and lyrics stage. It integrates NetEase/QQ Music APIs, 3D playlist browsing, and custom cover support. The project is currently archived.

repos.description: 一款以电影镜头、粒子视觉和歌词舞台为核心的沉浸式音乐播放器。
repos.summary_zh: Mineradio 是一款基于 Electron 的 Windows 桌面沉浸式音乐播放器，深度融合电影级镜头、粒子视觉与歌词舞台。它集成了 Open-Meteo 天气电台、网易云/QQ 音乐多平台接入及 3D 歌单架，通过节奏驱动的视觉系统为用户打造极具现场感的私人音乐空间。
repos.summary_en: Mineradio is an Electron-based Windows desktop immersive music player that deeply integrates cinematic camera effects, particle visuals, and lyric stages. Featuring Open-Meteo weather radio, multi-platform music integration (NetEase/QQ), and a 3D playlist shelf, it creates a highly engaging private music space driven by rhythm-based visual systems.

repos.description: A modern self-hosted music player.
repos.summary_zh: Feishin 是一款现代化的自托管音乐播放器，支持 MPV 和 Web 播放器后端，提供现代化 UI、智能播放列表编辑、歌词同步与反同步功能，并支持将播放记录同步至服务器，适用于个人音乐库管理与流媒体播放。
repos.summary_en: Feishin is a modern self-hosted music player featuring MPV and web player backends, a sleek UI, smart playlist editing, synchronized lyrics, and playback scrobbling to your server, ideal for managing personal music libraries and streaming.

repos.description: 插件化、定制化、无广告的免费音乐播放器
repos.summary_zh: MusicFree 桌面版是一款插件化、无广告的免费音乐播放器，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。其核心特性包括：通过插件机制接入任意音源（如搜索、播放、歌单导入），高度定制化主题系统（支持 CSS 变量与 iframe 背景），以及本地数据存储保障隐私。用户可自由扩展音源与界面风格，实现个性化音乐体验。
repos.summary_en: MusicFree Desktop is a plugin-based, ad-free, open-source music player supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. Key features include: plugin-driven access to any audio source (search, playback, playlist import), highly customizable themes via CSS variables and iframe backgrounds, and local data storage for privacy. Users can extend sources and personalize UI freely.

repos.description: 网易云音乐第三方
repos.summary_zh: ieaseMusic 是一款基于 Electron、React 和 MobX 构建的优雅网易云音乐第三方桌面客户端，支持跨平台（macOS/Linux/Windows）、高音质（FLAC）、键盘操作、桌面通知、Last.fm 听歌记录同步、多平台音源修复（如 QQ 音乐、虾米等）、社交分享及微信扫码登录，集成 Alfred 3 工作流，提供现代化 UI 与下载功能。
repos.summary_en: ieaseMusic is an elegant third-party Netease Music desktop app built with Electron, React, and MobX. It supports cross-platform use (macOS/Linux/Windows), high-quality FLAC audio, keyboard shortcuts, desktop notifications, Last.fm scrobbling, multi-source link fixing (e.g., QQ, Xiami), social sharing, WeChat login, and includes an Alfred 3 workflow for quick access.

repos.description: A lightweight screen recorder based on ScreenCapture Kit for macOS / 基于 ScreenCapture Kit 的轻量化多功能 macOS 录屏工具
repos.summary_zh: QuickRecorder 是一款基于 ScreenCapture Kit 的轻量级高性能 macOS 录屏工具，支持屏幕、窗口、应用及移动设备录制。具备免驱音频回环、鼠标高亮、屏幕放大镜等功能，并完整支持 macOS 14 的 Presenter Overlay 实时摄像头叠加，以及 HEVC with Alpha 格式输出（含透明通道），适用于专业视频制作与会议录制。
repos.summary_en: QuickRecorder is a lightweight, high-performance screen recorder for macOS built on ScreenCapture Kit. It supports recording screens, windows, apps, and mobile devices with features like driver-free audio loopback, mouse highlighting, and screen magnifier. It fully supports macOS 14's Presenter Overlay for real-time camera overlay and HEVC with Alpha output (with alpha channel), ideal for professional video editing and conferencing.

repos.description: Claude Skill: Multi-source content processor for NotebookLM. Supports WeChat articles, web pages, YouTube, PDF, Markdown, search queries → Podcast/PPT/MindMap/Quiz etc.
repos.summary_zh: qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm 是一个 Claude Code Skill，支持将微信公众号、网页、YouTube、PDF、Markdown 等 15 种以上内容源自动处理并上传至 Google NotebookLM，生成播客、PPT、思维导图、Quiz 等多种输出格式。其核心亮点是内置 6 层付费墙绕过机制，可自动提取 300+ 付费网站内容，结合 AI 实现多模态内容转换。
repos.summary_en: qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm is a Claude Code Skill that processes 15+ content sources—including WeChat articles, web pages, YouTube, PDF, and Markdown—and uploads them to Google NotebookLM to generate outputs like podcasts, PPTs, mind maps, and quizzes. Its standout feature is a 6-layer paywall bypass system that automatically extracts content from 300+ premium news sites, enabling AI-powered multimodal content transformation.

repos.description: ✨ AsrTools: Smart Voice-to-Text Tool | Efficient Batch Processing | User-Friendly Interface | No GPU Required | Supports SRT/TXT Output | Turn your audio into accurate text in an instant!
repos.summary_zh: AsrTools 是一款智能语音转文字工具，支持批量音频/视频文件处理，提供 SRT/TXT/字幕文件输出，具备高颜值 PyQt5 界面与多线程并发能力，无需 GPU 即可快速生成准确文本，适用于字幕制作与语音内容提取。
repos.summary_en: AsrTools is an intelligent voice-to-text tool that supports batch processing of audio and video files, generating SRT/TXT/subtitle outputs with a user-friendly PyQt5 interface. It uses multi-threading for fast conversion, requires no GPU, and enables instant text extraction from media files.

repos.description: 一个基于 AI 的 Hacker News 中文播客项目，每天自动抓取 Hacker News 热门文章，通过 AI 生成中文总结并转换为播客内容。
repos.summary_zh: Agili 的 Hacker Podcast 是一个基于 AI 的 Hacker News 中文播客项目，每日自动抓取热门文章，利用 AI 生成中文摘要并转换为语音播客。项目采用 Cloudflare Workers 部署，结合 OpenAI API 与 TTS 技术，支持多平台订阅，实现技术资讯的自动化聚合与分发。
repos.summary_en: Agili's Hacker Podcast is an AI-powered Chinese podcast project that automatically fetches daily top articles from Hacker News, generates Chinese summaries via AI, and converts them into audio content. Built with Cloudflare Workers, OpenAI API, and TTS, it supports multi-platform RSS and web access for automated tech news aggregation.

repos.description: 高颜值的第三方网易云播放器；通过自写插件可支持其他线上音乐服务；支持流媒体音乐，如navidrome、jellyfin、emby；支持本地音乐播放、离线歌单、逐字歌词、桌面歌词、Touch Bar歌词、Mac状态栏歌词显示、Linux-gnome与Linux-kde桌面状态栏歌词显示；支持降调降速，支持自定义主题等。支持 Windows / macOS / Linux :electron:
repos.summary_zh: VutronMusic 是一款高颜值跨平台第三方网易云音乐播放器，支持本地音乐、流媒体服务（如Navidrome、Jellyfin）、离线歌单及逐字歌词。具备桌面歌词、状态栏歌词、变调变速、自定义主题等功能，采用 Vue3 + TypeScript + Fastify 架构，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux 多平台。
repos.summary_en: VutronMusic is a high-end third-party NetEase Cloud Music player supporting local music, streaming services (Navidrome, Jellyfin), offline playlists, and karaoke-style lyrics. Features include desktop lyrics, system tray display, pitch/speed control, custom themes, and advanced audio effects. Built with Vue3, TypeScript, Fastify, and Electron for cross-platform support.

repos.description: Python爬虫，返回一定格式的信息，下载，使用flask提供简易api。抖音无水印、皮皮虾、快手、网易云音乐、qq音乐、咪咕音乐、荔枝FM音频、知乎视频、最右语音、视频、微博......
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Python 的网页爬虫集合，支持抖音、快手、网易云音乐、知乎等平台的无水印视频、音频及内容下载，通过 Flask 提供简易 API 接口。代码风格较旧但功能实用，现计划迁移至 FastAPI 框架重构，适合学习或日常使用。
repos.summary_en: This project is a collection of Python web crawlers for downloading unwatermarked videos, audio, and content from platforms like Douyin, Kuaishou, NetEase Music, and Zhihu. It provides a simple API via Flask. The codebase is outdated but functional, with plans to migrate to FastAPI for better structure and usability.

repos.description: Versatile downloader for audio, video, podcasts, PDFs and more. Available as CLI and Docker | 多功能下载工具，支持音视频、播客、PDF等，提供 CLI 和 Docker 两种方式
repos.summary_zh: vget 是一款多功能下载工具，支持从音视频、播客、社交媒体（如小红书、Twitter）及WebDAV等资源下载内容，提供 CLI 和 Docker 部署方式，具备多语言支持和交互式配置向导，适用于跨平台自动化下载场景。
repos.summary_en: vget is a versatile downloader supporting audio, video, podcasts, PDFs, and social media content from platforms like Xiaohongshu and Twitter. It offers CLI and Docker deployment, multi-language support, and interactive configuration, ideal for cross-platform automated downloads.

repos.description: Beans Music - iOS 26 液态玻璃风格第三方音乐播放器（仅供学习）
repos.summary_zh: 基于 SwiftUI 构建的 iOS 第三方音乐播放器，采用 iOS 26 液态玻璃设计语言，聚合网易云音乐与 QQ 音乐双平台数据。支持歌词深度定制、动态封面取色、自由布局调整及一键备份，提供沉浸式本地化体验。
repos.summary_en: A SwiftUI-based third-party iOS music player featuring iOS 26 Liquid Glass design. Aggregates NetEase Cloud Music and QQ Music with deep lyric customization, dynamic cover color extraction, free layout adjustment, and one-click backup for an immersive localized experience.

repos.description: Lenny Rachitsky 播客与 Newsletter 知识库。搜索、阅读、学习 Lenny 的 638 篇内容（289 播客转录 + 349 篇 Newsletter）。 涵盖产品管理、增长、设计、工程、AI、创业、领导力等 17 个主题。 触发词：Lenny、Lenny's Newslet
repos.summary_zh: Lenny Rachitsky播客与Newsletter知识库，将638篇硅谷顶级产品内容（289篇播客转录+349篇Newsletter）转化为可自然语言搜索的知识库。支持Claude Code调用，覆盖产品管理、增长、设计、AI等17个主题，提供带来源引用的精准问答服务。
repos.summary_en: A searchable knowledge base for Lenny Rachitsky's 638 podcast transcripts and newsletter articles, enabling natural language queries via Claude Code. Covers 17 topics including product management, growth, AI, and leadership, with source-attributed answers from top Silicon Valley content.

repos.description: ToMic - Turn Your Phone into a PC Microphone
repos.summary_zh: ToMic 是一款基于 Web 技术的局域网虚拟麦克风工具，可将手机浏览器作为电脑的麦克风输入源。通过 Wi-Fi 传输音频流，并利用虚拟声卡（如 BlackHole 或 VB-CABLE）实现低延迟音频路由，适用于 Zoom、Teams、Discord 等会议场景，无需安装 App，支持 macOS 和 Windows 平台。
repos.summary_en: ToMic is a Web-based LAN virtual microphone tool that turns your phone into a PC microphone via browser. It streams audio over Wi-Fi using WebSocket and Opus encoding, then routes it through virtual sound cards (e.g., BlackHole or VB-CABLE) for low-latency input in apps like Zoom, Teams, or Discord. No app installation required on mobile, with native support for macOS and Windows.
